game: Standard 3x3, X opens on the empty board with probability 1, stop on first win or full board. Moves are row-major 0 through 8.
payoff: Terminal X win +1, draw 0, O win -1. Both players follow the same frozen source after the candidate first move. Maximize for X and minimize for O. No discount or intermediate rewards.
tie_rule: Smallest legal cell index among exact maxima from the mover's perspective. Use rational arithmetic for exact return ties and ordinary equality for network scores.

source_definitions.minimax: Exact minimax to terminal, with the declared tie rule.
source_definitions.miss_win: When an immediate win and a nonwinning move both exist, take the smallest nonwinning move. Otherwise use the frozen heuristic.
source_definitions.heuristic: Repository heuristic at b99d663: win, block, center, corners, remaining legal moves.
source_definitions.trained_net: Frozen 10-16-9 tanh policy, legal argmax. Supervised imitation of the heuristic on sorted unique training-split positions from uniform random games.
source_definitions.stochastic_heuristic: Draw a fresh mixture independently at each decision. Follow the heuristic with probability 3/4 and choose a uniform legal move with probability 1/4.

random_opponents.decoder: Frozen 10-16-9 tanh, legal argmax. Equal weight within family.

split.rule: Empty board is test to guarantee positive test visitation. For all other positions take the lexicographically smallest board tuple across D4 under O < empty < X. Encode as O.X symbols, concatenate salt + ':' + board, and take the first four SHA-256 bytes as a big-endian integer modulo 100. Buckets below 65 train, 65 to 79 validation, remaining test. Preserve oriented labels.

endpoints.primary: Exact greedy recovery on all nonterminal boards, learned successor V on held-out test boards. Report every formulation under both uniform board weight and exact source self-play visitation, renormalized within the split. Thresholds are inclusive.

recovery.design: Use every train decision for policy and Q. Use actual frozen source actions, one per board for deterministic sources or eight independent draws for the stochastic source. V uses train positions including terminals, excluding successors of any validation/test decision. No validation/test input or symmetry equivalent is supervised for its corresponding prediction. Rollout trajectories may traverse held-out positions. Use separate RNG streams for action, V and Q labels, reset for each source. Traverse boards in ascending ply then ASCII board order, legal moves ascending. One rollout suffices for deterministic sources. Train on X-perspective Monte Carlo returns. No terminal shortcut at decoding for either learned V or Q. No tuning, early stopping or replacement seeds.
recovery.stochastic_decoder: The exact behavioral control normalizes log probabilities. The policy imitation network uses its masked temperature-one softmax for stochastic sources and legal argmax otherwise. Both return networks act greedily for all sources.

gameplay: Play complete games from the empty board. Evaluate each participant as X and O with weight 1/2, against all opponents and separately against its own source. Compute the entire outcome distribution by recursion with no sampled matches. Report W/D/L, W-L and same-opponent same-seat differences from the original source. Overall panel weights are by family. Head-to-head has zero panel weight.
calibration: On held-out decision boards compare V(s) to exact V(s) and Q(s,a) and V(T(s,a)) to exact Q(s,a) on every legal candidate. Report mean predictions and truths, MSE and counts in five fixed prediction bins with boundaries -0.6,-0.2,0.2,0.6 and open tails.
